                    os.system(raw_cmd)

                    os.system("clear")
                else:

stop_event = threading.Event()
current_step = 0
user_input_buffer = []
input_lock = threading.Lock()

def translate_weather_to_icon(condition_text):
    text = condition_text.lower()
    icons = []
    if "thunder" in text or "storm" in text:
        icons.append("⛈️")
    elif "rain" in text or "drizzle" in text or "shower" in text:

        icons.append("⛅")
    if "sun" in text or "clear" in text or "fair" in text:
        icons.append("☀️")
    if not icons:
        return "🌡️"
    return "".join(icons)

def get_weather_status():
    try:
        url = "https://wttr.in/?format=%C+%t"
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, 
            headers={'User-Agent': 'curl'}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=1.5) as response:
            weather_data = response.read().decode('utf-8').strip()
            if "<html" in weather_data.lower():
                return False, "Data Error", "🌡️"
            
            parts = weather_data.split(' ')
            temp = parts[-1] if parts else ""
            condition_desc = " ".join(parts[:-1]) if len(parts) > 1 else weather_data
            
            weather_icon = translate_weather_to_icon(condition_desc)
            return True, temp, weather_icon
    except Exception:
        return False, "Offline", "🌡️"

def get_current_status(step):
    is_online, temp_info, weather_icon = get_weather_status()
    
    if step % 2 == 0:
        robot_icon = "⚡ 🤖 ⚡"
    else:
        robot_icon = "  🤖  "
        
    temp_display = f"{weather_icon} {temp_info}".strip() if temp_info != "Offline" else "🌡️ Offline"
    
    # คงตำแหน่งหุ่นยนต์ไว้ฝั่งซ้ายต่อจากอุณหภูมิแบบเดิม
    return f"{temp_display}  {robot_icon}"

def redraw_screen(step):
    status_line = get_current_status(step)
    
    try:
        terminal_width = os.get_terminal_size().columns
    except OSError:
        terminal_width = 40
        
    line_length = max(10, terminal_width - 2)
    
    sys.stdout.write("\033[s")
    
    sys.stdout.write("\033[1;1H\033[K")
    sys.stdout.write(status_line)
    
    sys.stdout.write("\033[2;1H\033[K")
    sys.stdout.write("-" * line_length)
    
    sys.stdout.write("\033[3;1H\033[K")
    dollar_icon = "$" if step % 2 == 0 else " "
    with input_lock:
        current_text = "".join(user_input_buffer)
    sys.stdout.write(f"{dollar_icon} {current_text}")
    
    sys.stdout.write("\033[u")
    sys.stdout.flush()

def background_engine():
    global current_step
    while not stop_event.is_set():
        current_step = (current_step + 1) % 2
        redraw_screen(current_step)
        time.sleep(0.5)

def ai_smart_reply(user_msg):
    msg = user_msg.lower()

        }

        return f"วันนี้คือ{current_day_th} ที่ {now.strftime('%d/%m/%Y')} ครับป๋า! 📅"
    elif "เวลา" in msg or "กี่โมง" in msg:
        return f"เวลาตอนนี้คือ {datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')} น. ครับป๋า ⏰"
    elif "สวัสดี" in msg or "ดีครับ" in msg:
        return "สวัสดีครับ! พร้อมรับคำสั่งครับป๋า 🤖✨"
    else:
        return f"รับทราบคำสั่ง: \"{user_msg}\" เรียบร้อยครับป๋า 👍"

    try:

        print("\n👋 ยกเลิกและปิดระบบเรียบร้อยครับ")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
